content.short: Huma Finance is a PayFi protocol enabling undercollateralized lending by tokenizing real-world income streams.
content.description: Huma Finance is a pioneering Payment Finance (PayFi) protocol that bridges decentralized finance with real-world credit. Securing significant funding to expand its network, Huma enables undercollateralized lending by allowing businesses to borrow against future income and receivables. This approach tokenizes real-world receivables, providing instant liquidity to creditworthy borrowers without traditional 1:1 asset backing. The protocol features a modular risk engine and offers both permissionless and institutional-grade environments for sustainable global payments and growth.
